+# Minimum widths of the name and version columns in "info" listings; they
+# grow to fit the longest value so that nothing is truncated.
+NAME_WIDTH = 20
+VERSION_WIDTH = 20
+
+
+def make_head(name_width, version_width):
+    return ("-" * 9 + "|----|" + "-" * (name_width + 2) + "|" +
+            "-" * (version_width + 2) + "|" + "-" * 15)
+
+
+def make_foot_margin(name_width, version_width):
+    return " " * (9 + 6 + 1 + name_width + 2 + 1 + version_width + 2 + 2)
